differences.what: the deck's cresting: a dense ring of open ironwork round the deck, where the build stood four posts and a rail
differences.how: T-1934: three rails, a bar every 0.16 m and a spear on every third, 0.75 m high, round both decks (open_cresting)

differences.what: a tall tapered spire at the deck's corners, rising well over the cresting
differences.how: T-1934: a post at each deck corner carrying a 1.2 m tapered spire over the cresting; the corners the pictures do not show carry one too (reconstructed)

differences.what: the moulded stone belt course the upper storey stands on, where the build showed the lower roof's slope as a band of slate under the upper sash (the owner named the belt course, 2026-10-28)
differences.how: T-1934: a two-member stone course, about 0.36 m deep, its top where the lower slope meets the wall (4.41 m on the 18th Street front, 4.60 m on the west face, whose slope is steeper), and the upper sash raised onto it from 4.3 m; the lower roof's eave cut on the diagonal where the upper storey turns the corner, so its square hip no longer stands in front of the corner wall

differences.what: the stable's cornices, belt course and the belvedere's cornice in the walls' light stone, where the build drew them in the dark cornice tone
differences.how: T-1934: the stable's stone mouldings drawn in the light trim stone

differences.what: the corner bay's cap rising to a point over the corner
differences.how: T-1934: a low slope onto a flat top, as the 1894 plate draws it; this print shows the corner through trees

differences.what: the corner bay: the print puts it about 1.4 m further west, standing directly against the drum, and reads it rounder than the build's three faces
differences.how: two pictures disagree (the plate puts it about 0.8 m further east); the build stands between them

differences.what: the lantern: the print reads its dome taller and rounder, rising about 2 m over the cresting where the build's rises about 0.9 m
differences.how: two pictures disagree: the 1894 plate reads the lantern's cap within about 0.3 m of the build

differences.what: the upper sash of two lights each in moulded frames
differences.how: glazing bars under the bar; the openings' number, place and size agree

differences.what: the 18th Street boundary: a low stone wall with square piers and a coping along the walk, a lamp post by the court, and the clipped shrubs and young trees behind it
differences.how: the lot's grounds, judged in the match (the owner, 2026-10-28); none of it is built

differences.what: the house is a light stone in the print, the build draws it red brick
differences.how: the house's own records judge it (T-1881); rendered here for placement only

_how: verdict is unreviewed | differs | matches, set by whoever compared the side-by-side with the picture; each difference is {what, status: open | fixed | not shown | within tolerance | owner ruling} — open only if a street visitor would notice it (over about 1 ft, missing, mis-shaped, miscounted, wrong material or colour), else within tolerance (T-3153); owner ruling where the owner asked the build to depart from the picture (T-3236).
